CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFIMPERSONATE

CFIMPERSONATE authenticates a user and runs the code between its start and end tags with that user's identity, so security checks such as IsAuthorized answer for that user. When the end tag is reached, the previous identity (or none) is restored.

Category

Security

Syntax

<CFIMPERSONATE SECURITYCONTEXT="context"
    USERNAME="user_ID"
    PASSWORD="password"
    TYPE="CF/OS"
    LOGIN="domain">
  code that runs as that user
</CFIMPERSONATE>

Attributes

SECURITYCONTEXT
Required for TYPE="CF". The security context whose user directories hold the user.
USERNAME
Required. The user to impersonate.
PASSWORD
Required. That user's password.
TYPE
Optional, default "CF". CF impersonates a user of Advanced Security. OS would impersonate a Windows NT account; KoldFusion does not run on NT, so TYPE="OS" always throws an error.
LOGIN
Optional. The NT domain for TYPE="OS". Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.

Usage

If the user name or password is wrong, or the context does not exist, the tag throws an exception of TYPE="Security" with the message "Impersonation failed." and the body does not run.

Unlike CFAUTHENTICATE, CFIMPERSONATE sends no cookie and lasts only until its end tag. It is meant for short stretches of code that need someone else's permissions, such as a page that lets the help desk run a report on behalf of a user.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- Try both kinds of impersonation and report what happens --->
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=4>
<TR><TH>TYPE</TH><TH>Result</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP LIST="CF,OS" INDEX="ImpType">
  <CFOUTPUT><TR><TD>#ImpType#</TD><TD></CFOUTPUT>
  <CFTRY>
    <CFIMPERSONATE SECURITYCONTEXT="Snippets" USERNAME="reports"
        PASSWORD="reports" TYPE="#ImpType#">
      <CFOUTPUT>Running as #AuthenticatedUser()#.
      May read the reports directory:
      #IsAuthorized("File", "/reports/*", "Read")#</CFOUTPUT>
    </CFIMPERSONATE>
  <CFCATCH TYPE="Security">
    <CFOUTPUT><B>#CFCATCH.Message#</B> #CFCATCH.Detail#</CFOUTPUT>
  </CFCATCH>
  </CFTRY>
  </TD></TR>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
<CFOUTPUT><P>After the end tag, AuthenticatedUser() is "#AuthenticatedUser()#".</CFOUTPUT>
